offer.text: The wall's breached where the raiders came through, and a gap in the stone is an invitation. Set sixteen stone bricks along the breach and make it whole again.

accept.text: Good. Lay them true — a crooked wall is half a wall.

decline.text: Then the gap gapes, and we all sleep lighter for it.

in_progress.text: How's the breach coming? Stone by stone, that's the way.

ready.text: Solid masonry, flush and square. The wall holds again.

complete.text: Honest work, honestly done. The village stands a little safer for your hands.
